title: Heavenly Secrets First Manifest
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji had not yet digested that fateful prophecy, the sky outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate suddenly tore apart a blood-colored rift—a celestial phenomenon that only appears when a Transformation God realm expert strikes with full force."

text.content: "The moment that blood-colored rift tore through the firmament, the calm lake of Chen Ji's heart suddenly erupted into turbulent waves. He sat cross-legged in the most remote corner of the Servants' Quarters, within a meditation chamber, his surrounding spiritual energy barely beginning to stir when this sudden celestial upheaval abruptly interrupted. Outside the window, blood-colored light pierced through the thin paper, casting eerie red spots on the ground, like countless prying eyes. A flash of brilliant light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes as his mind rapidly calculated: a Transformation God realm expert striking with full force? Such a commotion was absolutely not something ordinary disciples could ignite. Could something major have happened to the sect?"

"He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. The Servants' Quarters would certainly be in turmoil now—if he recklessly went outside at this moment, he would instead easily draw unnecessary attention. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into the Mental Sea—there, a yellowed fragment floated silently in the Void, emanating a faint ancient aura. This was his greatest trump card: the Tianji Record. On the fragment, he had barely grasped the abilities of the first two layers, yet had never touched the threshold of the third layer."

"An aged and ethereal voice rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. On the fragment, a blurry light shadow slowly coalesced, taking the form of that guardian. Chen Ji's heart tightened; he could sense the rare solemnity in Mo Xiansheng's words. This mysterious remnant soul guardian never spoke proactively on ordinary days, yet today he had broken the rule to appear—something must have alerted him."

dialogue.content: "That rift outside is the aftermath of a Transformation God realm expert performing a cross-realm teleportation. But this is not the direction you should be focusing on—the opportunity for the third layer of the Tianji Record has arrived."

text.content: "Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's heart was shaken beyond description. The third layer! He had attempted countless times to touch that forbidden boundary of the third layer, yet each time he was repelled by an invisible force, as if a shackle had firmly locked away the deeper mysteries. He tentatively probed his consciousness toward the depths of the fragment, where there had originally been a chaotic mist that now showed faint signs of loosening. Mo Xiansheng was right—that shackle... seemed to have developed cracks today."

"Just then, another muffled rumble echoed from the sky outside the meditation chamber. Chen Ji hesitated no longer, forming seals with both hands, pouring all his concentration into the Tianji Record. The fragment burst forth with dazzling golden light, that radiance carrying a burning temperature that instantly dispersed the mist in his Mental Sea. A mighty stream of information surged into his consciousness like a tide—it was... Causality!"

choice.prompt: "The third layer of Heavenly Secrets ability has been activated. Chen Ji will now foresee significant events within the next three hours for the first time. He now faces a choice:"

choices.description: "Control output, only foresight the most critical information, reduce Heavenly Fate consumption, avoid excessive burden on the body"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his surging emotions. He used intention as the reins, carefully guiding that flood of information, not seeking to glimpse the whole picture, only to capture the most critical threads of causality. The golden light on the fragment slightly dimmed, becoming gentle and stable. A blurry image slowly materialized before his eyes—it was... the entrance to a secret realm in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain?"

choices.description: "Release the entire third layer ability without restraint, obtain the most complete information, but Heavenly Fate consumption doubles, body may fall into weakness"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain complete foresight, glimpse part of the third page text of the Tianji Record"

text.content: "A fierce glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Since the shackle had already opened, why not go all in? He abruptly mobilized all his divine sense, allowing that flood of information to recklessly wash over his consciousness. The golden light on the fragment surged to its limit, making his Mental Sea ache faintly. However, the price was worth it—a complete and clear scroll unfurled before his eyes."

choices.description: "First observe the patterns of the shackle loosening, attempt to activate the third layer ability with minimal cost"
choices.visible_reward: "Comprehend partial patterns, lay foundation for subsequent use"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not rush for success. He transformed his consciousness into countless fine threads, gently touching the cracks in that shackle. Once, twice, thrice... He acutely noticed that whenever solar and lunar essence alternated or when spiritual energy tides surged, the shackle would briefly loosen. Finally, he found the timing and struck decisively during the next spiritual energy fluctuation."

"The image gradually clarified. Chen Ji saw a deep valley shrouded in dense fog—that was the Forbidden Grounds secret realm of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Within the mist, a hunched figure was slowly advancing. Though the mist obscured the figure's features, Chen Ji recognized the visitor through the threads of causality—the old Sect Master, Ling Yuan!"

"In the foresight, Ling Yuan ventured alone deep into the heart of the secret realm, with no disciples accompanying him. He seemed to be searching for something, his pace sometimes fast, sometimes slow, as if following some ancient traces. Suddenly, Ling Yuan stopped, turned, and gazed into the Void—the direction he gazed toward was precisely where Chen Ji currently resided."

dialogue.content: "'Old man has waited for you, for a very long time.'"

text.content: "That voice traversed the barriers of time and space, echoing directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. This was not foresight, but—the resonance of causality! Ling Yuan actually knew he was observing? Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, a chill climbing from his spine to his heart. Yet in the next instant, the foresight image shifted again."

"In the deeper reaches of the secret realm, Ling Yuan arrived before a long-sealed altar. He slowly knelt, taking a broken Jade Slip from his bosom, quietly reciting something. The characters on that Jade Slip were identical to the runes on the Tianji Record fragment! Chen Ji instantly understood—Ling Yuan had once been a candidate for the Tianji Record's inheritance, yet had been cast aside by this mysterious scroll."

"Just then, the golden text on the third page of the fragment finally fully manifested. It was an obscure prophecy, each character like a blade, carving itself into Chen Ji's divine soul: 'Heaven's fate's shackle locks others, yet also locks oneself; to break this lock, only by trading life for life—yet life is not life, it is the weight of causality.'"

dialogue.content: "'Causality cannot be defied, Heaven's fate cannot be reversed... You think yourself a Chess Player, but you are merely a piece of chess wearing different clothes.'"

text.content: "That voice was ice-cold and vast, like Heaven's Way itself whispering. Chen Ji shuddered violently, an unprecedented fear seizing his heart. The Eye of Heaven's Way—that legendary supreme existence—was actually speaking to him here and now, in this manner! Was this a warning, or a verdict?"

"The final foresight image froze on the altar. Ling Yuan rose, placed that Jade Slip reverently at the altar's center, then turned and walked toward the secret realm's exit. His back was aged and desolate, yet the moment he stepped through the Forbidden Grounds barrier, he suddenly looked back, casting Chen Ji a deeply meaningful smile in his direction."

"The foresight ended here. Golden light dissipated, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. In the meditation chamber, everything was as before, only his forehead was beaded with cold sweat, his garments soaked through. A violent wave of weakness assaulted his body, as if all his strength had been drained. The price... had begun. He looked down at his hands—pale and nearly translucent, with faint black patterns visible beneath the skin—those were the consequences of massive Heavenly Fate consumption."

dialogue.content: "The third layer ability has stabilized. You have seen the causality three hours ahead. But remember—the clearer you see, the heavier the backlash. What you just witnessed has already cost you three months of your lifespan."

text.content: "Three months of lifespan! Chen Ji's mouth drew a bitter smile. This was the price of the Tianji Record—every glimpse of Heavenly Secrets was透支 his own life. But he felt no regret. Ling Yuan was no enemy; that old fox with hidden malice had today actually taken the initiative to release goodwill. More importantly, he finally knew the method to break the shackle: trading life for life!"

"Only this 'life is not life' mystery requires careful contemplation. Chen Ji took a deep breath,勉强撑起weak的身体 pushed open the wooden door of the meditation chamber. The lingering glow of sunset scattered, lengthening his shadow into a thin line. He knew that from today onward, everything had changed. Heavenly Secrets first manifest, the chess game has shifted, and he... will ultimately escape this Heaven's Way-manipulated game of chess."

"In the distance, that blood-colored rift had slowly healed, the sky returning to its former tranquility. But Chen Ji knew this was merely a brief calm before the storm. In three days, Ling Yuan would await him in the depths of the secret realm,，届时将有一个足以颠覆他认知的真相等待揭晓 an earth-shattering truth awaiting revelation. And before then, he must find a way to recover his consumed Heavenly Fate while also comprehending the true meaning of the third page's prophecy. After all, trading life for life... how exactly should this 'life' be 'traded'?"
